# MovieWeb

> > MovieWeb is an entertainment news publication covering movies, TV shows, streaming releases, and pop culture with a focus on superhero franchises, streaming platform updates, and film industry analysis.

MovieWeb delivers breaking news about theatrical releases, streaming debuts on platforms like Netflix and HBO Max, behind-the-scenes production stories, and critical reception tracking through Rotten Tomatoes scores. The site covers major entertainment properties including Marvel, DC Universe films from James Gunn, classic franchises, and emerging streaming content across animation, action, horror, and prestige cinema.

## Key Topics

- Netflix streaming releases
- HBO Max content and pricing
- Marvel Cinematic Universe
- James Gunn's DCU
- Rotten Tomatoes scores
- A24 films
- Streaming platform news
- Superhero movies and TV
- Animation and anime
- Film trailers and first looks
- Theatrical vs streaming releases
- Classic film retrospectives
- Warner Bros Discovery
- Sundance Film Festival coverage
